cases.name: Scenario: create Region
cases.reason: Feature exists (TypeLocationsPaper.jsx + EditLocationDialog.jsx) but original steps are in reverse order and 'click add' is now 'Save' in a dialog titled 'New Region'.
cases.prerequisites: Logged in as demo superuser Admin / admin123 (tblUsers LoginName 'Admin', other names/last name 'Admin Admin'). Region create/edit/delete/move needs right RIGHT_REGION_LOCATION_ADD (LocationsPage.jsx passes onEdit/onDelete/onMove only when createRegionLocationRight; districts too) - Admin has it. Demo tree: R1 Ultha > R1D1 Rapta > R1D1M1 Achi > R1D1M1V1 Rachla; R2 Tahida > R2D1 Rajo / R2D2 Vida.
cases.rerun_strategy: Codes are free text up to 50 chars (location/models.py LocationCode max_length=50): use a unique prefix like 'UAT<timestamp>'. Build an isolated sub-tree under a test Region created in beforeAll and delete it (drop with children) in afterAll. All changes are async mutations: wait for the journal entry or for the list to refresh (expect.poll).
cases.selectors: Route location/locations (LocationModule/src/index.jsx, pages/LocationsPage.jsx): four papers titled 'Regions', 'Districts', 'Municipalities', 'Villages' (location.locations.searcher.title.N). Click on a row selects it and loads children; double-click opens edit dialog (needs edit right). Paper header icon buttons (no text/aria): 'add' (Add Location), 'replay' (refresh/filter). Row icon buttons with tooltip 'Move' (span 'shuffle') and 'Delete' (span 'delete'). Rows display '<code> - <name>'. Add/Edit dialog: title 'New <Type>' / 'Modify <Type> of <code> - <name>', fields 'Code' (async uniqueness: 'Location code already taken.'), 'Name', for villages also 'Male', 'Female', 'Other', 'Family'; buttons 'Save' (disabled until valid) / 'Cancel'. Delete dialog: title 'Delete <code> - <name> <Type>'; leaf: 'Are you sure you want to delete <Type> <code> - <name>?'; with children: 'Do you want to:' radio 'Delete ... and all its <children>' / 'Delete ... and move its <directChildren> to' + select; buttons 'Delete'/'Cancel'. Move dialog: 'Move <code> - <name> <Type>', read-only 'Current parent', 'New parent:' selects per level, buttons 'Move'/'Cancel'. Locator tip: scope with page.locator('.MuiPaper-root', {hasText: 'Districts'}); icon buttons via locator('button', {has: page.locator('span.material-symbols-outlined', {hasText: /^add$/})}).

proposed_steps.action: Open Administration > Locations (/front/location/locations).
proposed_steps.expected: Four panels 'Regions', 'Districts', 'Municipalities', 'Villages'; Regions lists e.g. 'R1 - Ultha', 'R2 - Tahida'.

cases.name: Change Language from English to French
cases.reason: Language switch exists but is no longer 'right of Insuree Enquiry': it is in the 'My account' app-bar dropdown (LanguageMenuItems.jsx); confirm dialog 'Confirm Language' with 'Confirm'/'Cancel'; page reloads after confirm.
cases.prerequisites: Logged in as demo superuser Admin / admin123 (tblUsers LoginName 'Admin', other names/last name 'Admin Admin'). fe-language_fr installed (frontend/openimis.json LanguageFrModule) and 'fr' present in backend languages. Alternatively use demo user 'Admin_Fr' (LanguageID 'fr').
cases.rerun_strategy: Changes the logged user's language (tblUsers.LanguageID) - always switch back to English in teardown or via GraphQL changeUserLanguage. RISK: confirm() dispatches the changeUserLanguage mutation and immediately calls window.location.reload() without awaiting it (useLanguageSwitcher.jsx), and with core.async_mutations the mutation is queued - the reload can come back in the old language. Assert with expect.poll + page.reload, and report as defect if it does not converge.
cases.selectors: Language switch is inside the app-bar dropdown 'My account' (CoreModule/src/index.jsx core.AppBarIcons entry {type:'language'}, components/LanguageMenuItems.jsx: one MenuItem per language, current one marked with a check). Because the dropdown already offers language, the standalone LanguageQuickPicker (globe button) is hidden by default (languageQuickPicker 'auto', helpers/utils.jsx shouldShowLanguageQuickPicker) unless a backend config overrides core.AppBarIcons. Confirm dialog (helpers/useLanguageSwitcher.jsx): title 'Confirm Language', message 'You are about to change the language to {language}. Do you want to proceed?', buttons 'Confirm' / 'Cancel'. Language names come from the backend languages table (e.g. 'English', 'Français').
